title: The Ruined Loincloth

questions.question: Thus said the Lord to Jeremiah: "Go and buy a linen... and put it around your waist, and do not dip it in water."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:1 (ESV): "Go and buy a linen loincloth and put it around your waist, and do not dip it in water."

questions.question: Where did the Lord tell Jeremiah to go and hide the loincloth?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:4 (ESV): "Take the loincloth that you have bought, which is around your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates and hide it there in a cleft of the rock."

questions.question: After many days, the Lord told Jeremiah to go back and get the loincloth. What condition was the loincloth in when he found it?
options: It was spoiled, good for nothing
questions.correctAnswer: It was spoiled, good for nothing
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:7 (ESV): "behold, the loincloth was spoiled; it was good for nothing."

questions.question: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah: "Thus says the Lord: Even so will I spoil the... of Judah and the great... of Jerusalem."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:9 (ESV): "Even so will I spoil the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem."

questions.question: "This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who stubbornly follow their own... and have gone after other gods to serve them and worship them, shall be like this loincloth, which is good for nothing."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:10 (ESV): "who stubbornly follow their own heart"

questions.question: "For as the loincloth clings to the waist of a man, so I made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah... to me, declares the Lord..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:11 (ESV): "so I made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to me, declares the Lord,"

questions.question: "...that they might be for me a people, a name, a... , and a glory, but they would not listen."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:11 (ESV): "that they might be for me a people, a name, a praise, and a glory, but they would not listen."

questions.question: The Lord said, "Every... shall be filled with wine." And they will say, "Do we not indeed know that every... shall be filled with wine?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:12 (ESV): "Every jug shall be filled with wine."

questions.question: "Then you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Behold, I will fill with... all the inhabitants of this land...'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:13 (ESV): "Behold, I will fill with drunkenness all the inhabitants of this land:"

questions.question: "And I will dash them one against another, fathers and sons together, declares the Lord. I will not pity or spare or have compassion, that I should not... them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:14 (ESV): "that I should not destroy them."

questions.question: "Hear and give ear; be not..., for the Lord has spoken."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:15 (ESV): "Hear and give ear; be not proud, for the Lord has spoken."

questions.question: "Give glory to the Lord your God before he brings..., before your feet stumble on the twilight mountains,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:16 (ESV): "Give glory to the Lord your God before he brings darkness,"

questions.question: "But if you will not listen, my soul will weep in secret for your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly and run down with tears, because the Lord's... has been taken captive."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:17 (ESV): "because the Lord's flock has been taken captive."

questions.question: "Can the Ethiopian change his... or the leopard his... ? Then also you can do good who are accustomed to do evil."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:23 (ESV): "Can the Ethiopian change his skin or the leopard his spots?"

questions.question: "This is your lot, the portion I have measured out to you, declares the Lord, because you have... me and trusted in lies."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 13:25 (ESV): "because you have forgotten me and trusted in lies."

key_verse_text: "Can the Ethiopian change his skin or the leopard his spots? Then also you can do good who are accustomed to do evil."
